summary.name: Recipe Box Cookbook: ClipDish
summary.one_liner: An iOS recipe app by Appjawn, LLC that scans handwritten or printed recipes, saves recipes from websites, and organizes them into collections with a cooking mode.
use_cases: Saving recipes from websites without ads or life stories
Organizing recipes into custom collections for meal prep or holidays
Creating a grocery list in Apple Reminders while cooking
Exporting recipes as printable PDF cards to share
summary.what_it_does: The app scans handwritten cards, cookbooks, and magazines using OCR, including multi-page sources. It extracts clean recipe text from any website, stripping out surrounding content. Recipes can be organized into custom collections and tagged, and searched by ingredients, cuisine, or tags. A Cooking Mode lets users move between multiple recipes while cooking, and PDF export creates recipe cards for sharing. The page also lists an AI Chef assistant for cooking questions and substitutions, and Apple Intelligence auto-categorization on iPhone 15 Pro and later.
notable: OCR scanning of handwritten cards and multi-page cookbooks
Apple Reminders integration for grocery lists
Cooking Mode for navigating multiple recipes
caveats: Premium access is a subscription: monthly $2.99, quarterly $7.99, or annual $19.99 (In-App Purchases)
Apple Intelligence categorization requires iPhone 15 Pro or later
Requires iOS 18.6 / iPadOS 18.6 / visionOS 2.6 or later
